_comment: Map spoken app nicknames to an executable path or command. Keys are matched case-insensitively and loosely (e.g. 'vs code' matches 'open VS Code'). Values can be a bare command on PATH (e.g. 'notepad') or a full path. These defaults assume Windows; edit them to match your machine.
_folders_comment: Optional shortcuts for file operations. Nicknames map to a base directory so you can say 'list files in downloads'.
